title: 2-Tube Coolant Adapter
lead: A new cone adapter for the 2-Tube Coolant machine, for vehicles with shorter, wider radiator openings, such as certain Dodge models.
benefits: Seals better on difficult radiator neck designs
Less chance of leaks or improper seating during the service
body: Effective immediately, the adapter ships with every new 2-Tube Coolant machine, which now includes four adapters.

figures.caption: The four adapters now included with the 2-Tube Coolant machine: 95391, 95392, 95398 (new) and 95393

parts: Cone adapter, 2-Tube Coolant, short wide radiator necks
New; now included with every machine
source: Vol. 26 No. 02 - New Adapter for 2 Tube Coolant.pdf
